description: Forward an email to new recipients. The original message's attachments are left out unless includeOriginalAttachments is true

attachments.description: Files to attach to the forward. Total size, together with forwarded original attachments, is capped at 25 MB

items.description: One attachment: give either path or content (base64) plus filename

content.description: Base64-encoded file content, used instead of path

contentType.description: MIME type. Inferred from the file extension when omitted

filename.description: File name shown to the recipient. Required with content; defaults to the file name of path

path.description: A file inside the folder the user set in EMAIL_MCP_ATTACHMENTS_DIR: its name, a path relative to that folder, or an absolute path inside it. Files anywhere else are refused, and path attachments are off when that variable is not set.

includeOriginalAttachments.description: Also forward the original message's attachments (default false). Leave it off unless the user asked for the files to go along

sourceFolder.description: Source folder (required for IMAP/iCloud when email is not in INBOX)

name: email_forward
